race.comment: FREEDOM FLAME (4) fought on gamely in stakes company last start, finishing fifth when asked to sustain a long run before the turn. She drops back in trip just 11 days after that run, but will have a senior hoop replacing an apprentice, and if they overdo it front, he can have the final say. SHADOW EAGLE (11) has been in good form in lesser company, and will drop down to 54kg with the step up in class here. He is reunited with top hoop Rochelle Milnes, and another honest effort can be expected. ALL TOO MYSTI (9) capped off some some solid form with an easy all the way win on the main course here 2 weeks ago. She races just as well around this circuit, and she will take some pegging back again. MALDINI (8) was much better when ridden off the pace and finishing fourth behind the third pick in the same race last start. He drops 4kg, and can't be underestimated at a good price. I CATCHEM FOX (1) has yet to hit his straps, and drops in class, and trip for this. Keep safe in all quaddies.
